name: Path of the Battlerager
summary: A spiked-armor brawler (traditionally dwarven) who turns their body into a weapon.

features.name: Battlerager Armor
features.short: Spiked armor: bonus action attack while raging; grapple damage.
features.summary: While wearing spiked armor and raging, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the spikes (1d4 piercing). Creatures you grapple take 3 piercing damage when you start or complete the grapple.

features.name: Reckless Abandon
features.short: Gain temp HP equal to CON when you attack recklessly while raging.
features.summary: When you use Reckless Attack while raging, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1).

features.name: Battlerager Charge
features.short: Dash as a bonus action while raging.
features.summary: You can take the Dash action as a bonus action while raging.

features.name: Spiked Retribution
features.short: Creatures that hit you in melee take 3 piercing.
features.summary: When a creature within 5 ft. hits you with a melee attack while you rage in spiked armor, it takes 3 piercing damage.
